title: SymfonyCon Brussels 2023
content:
is the global conference in English for Symfony and PHP developers. Two days of workshops (December 5-6) followed by two days (December 7-8) full of talks on PHP, Symfony and its ecosystem. SymfonyCon Brussels 2023

Join us and discover the amazing city of Brussels (Belgium) while you share fun and knowledge with developers from all around the World.

Check out all the conference details
